channel.title: UK Defence Journal - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from UK Defence Journal (ukdefencejournal.org.uk)

item.title: NATO commander hails Nordic military power in the Arctic
item.description: NATO Supreme Allied Commander Europe has highlighted the growing impact of Sweden and Finland on Alliance northern posture, describing their capabilities as a major enhancement to Arctic readiness. The post NATO commander hails Nordic military power in the Arctic first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Pressure grows on Scottish Government to build ships at home
item.description: The Scottish Government is facing renewed pressure to use national security provisions within UK subsidy law to support domestic shipbuilding, following a new parliamentary question tabled by Paul Sweeney MSP, the UK Defence Journal understands. The post Pressure grows on Scottish Government to build ships at home first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Can Europe build a credible nuclear deterrent without the US?
item.description: A new analysis by Dorcha Lee, a retired Irish Army Colonel and defence analyst, examines whether a seven-nation European consortium could provide a credible nuclear deterrent should the US nuclear umbrella be withdrawn. The post Can Europe build a credible nuclear deterrent without the US? first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy launches drive to speed up submarine maintenance
item.description: The Royal Navy has begun a major effort to accelerate submarine maintenance, with senior leadership warning that throughput must improve rapidly to meet future operational demands. The post Royal Navy launches drive to speed up submarine maintenance first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK to mass-produce Ukrainian air defence drones
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has set out new details on Project Octopus, a joint UK–Ukraine defence industrial initiative aimed at rapidly scaling air defence drone production for use in the war against Russia. The post UK to mass-produce Ukrainian air defence drones first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK helicopters train in Arctic as Operation Clockwork runs
item.description: UK military helicopters have deployed to northern Norway as Commando Helicopter Force begins its annual Arctic training deployment under Operation Clockwork. The post UK helicopters train in Arctic as Operation Clockwork runs first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Army sets out service life for key armoured engineer fleet
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed the planned out-of-service dates for several British Army armoured engineering and support vehicles, outlining how long core elements of the fleet are expected to remain in use. The post Army sets out service life for key armoured engineer fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: UK avoids ruling out force against Russian shadow fleet
item.description: In a written question, Lord West of Spithead asked why Maritime Counter-Terrorism forces were not being used to stop vessels linked to Russia’s shadow fleet when transiting the Channel or other waters close to the UK. The post UK avoids ruling out force against Russian shadow fleet first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Defence signs logistics mobilisation pact with nine firms
item.description: The Ministry of Defence has confirmed it is working with industry to improve the UK ability to mobilise logistics personnel during times of crisis, following a parliamentary question on workforce preparedness. The post Defence signs logistics mobilisation pact with nine firms first appeared on UK Defence Journal.

item.title: Royal Navy tracks Russian shadow tanker off Gibraltar
item.description: Royal Navy forces monitored a sanctioned Russian-linked oil tanker as it transited the Strait of Gibraltar, ahead of a subsequent French boarding operation, as part of wider allied efforts to disrupt Moscow’s so-called shadow fleet. The post Royal Navy tracks Russian shadow tanker off Gibraltar first appeared on UK Defence Journal.
